1.w: For the one directing. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm. Hear this, all [you] peoples; give ear, all [you] dwellers of the world,

2.w: both sons of a man and sons of a [great] man, the rich and the poor together!

3.w: My mouth will speak wisdom, and a declaration of my heart, understanding.

4.w: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will open up my riddle with the harp.

5.w: Why should I fear in the days of evil, the perversion [that] surrounds me [at] my heels,

6.w: those trusting in their wealth, and [who] boast in the abundance of their riches?

7.w: A brother surely cannot ransom a man, and he cannot give to God his redemption price.

8.w: For costly [is] the ransom of their soul, and it shall cease forever,

9.w: that he might live on forever, [and] not see the Pit.

10.w: For he sees wise men die; the fool and the senseless one perish together, and they leave their wealth for others.

11.w: Their inward thoughts [are] their homes forever, their dwelling places from generation to generation, they proclaimed over the lands their own names.

12.w: And man in [his] wealth does not remain; he becomes like the beasts that perish.

13.w: This [is] their path of folly for them, and after them in their sayings they took delight. Selah

14.w: like sheep they are appointed for Sheol, [and] death will be their shepherd; the upright will rule over them in the morning, and their form shall be consumed [in] Sheol—the habitation for him.

15.w: Surely God will redeem my soul from the hand of Sheol, for He shall take me. Selah

16.w: do not be afraid when a man becomes rich, when the glory of his house increases.

17.w: For in his death he will take of it all nothing; his glory will not go down after him,

18.w: though his soul, in his living, he blesses, and they praise you when you do well for yourself.

19.w: He will come to the generation of his fathers; even to forever they shall not see light.

20.w: A man in [his] splendor does not understand; he is like the beasts that perish!
